chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from 'Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, that he heard Aba Ja'far عليه السلام saying:
Turning away breaks the salat (prayer) when it is done with the whole body.

key_terms.اَلِالْتِفَاتُ: turning away or shifting one's direction during salat (prayer)
key_terms.بِكُلِّهِ: with the whole of oneself, meaning with the entire body

ai.seo_question: Does turning away during salat (prayer) invalidate the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding salat (prayer), stating that full turning away invalidates the prayer. It indicates the importance of maintaining proper orientation and composure during worship.
